gloss: to use; to utilize; to make use of

definitions.gloss: to use; to utilize; to make use of
definitions.explanation: To employ something for a practical purpose or to one's advantage.

definitions.gloss: to take advantage of; to exploit
definitions.explanation: To use someone or something in a self-serving or manipulative way.

examples.japanese: バスを{利用|りよう}する。
{図書館|としょかん}を{利用|りよう}して{勉強|べんきょう}した。
このサービスは{誰|だれ}でも{無料|むりょう}で{利用|りよう}することができます。
examples.english: Anyone can use this service for free.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{弱|よわ}みを{利用|りよう}する。
{彼|かれ}は{友人|ゆうじん}の{親切|しんせつ}を{利用|りよう}していた。
examples.english: He was taking advantage of his friend's kindness.

examples.japanese: あの{会社|かいしゃ}は{消費者|しょうひしゃ}の{不安|ふあん}を{利用|りよう}して{商品|しょうひん}を{売|う}りつけている。
examples.english: That company exploits consumers' anxieties to push its products.

notes:
A very common verb meaning to use or make use of something. It implies purposeful, practical usage — often of facilities, services, or systems — rather than simply handling an object.

USAGE:
- Takes the particle を: ～を{利用|りよう}する
- The noun form {利用|りよう} is extremely common on its own, appearing on signs and in official documents
- Can have a negative connotation (sense 2) when the object is a person or someone's feelings

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}を{利用|りよう}する: to use public transportation
- サービスを{利用|りよう}する: to use a service
- {施設|しせつ}を{利用|りよう}する: to use a facility
- {機会|きかい}を{利用|りよう}する: to take advantage of an opportunity
- {利用|りよう}{可能|かのう}: available for use
- {利用|りよう}{者|しゃ}: user
- {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}: terms of use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {使|つか}う: to use — the most general word for using; {利用|りよう}する is more formal and implies purposeful use of resources or services
- {活用|かつよう}する: to make good use of, to put to practical use — emphasizes effective or skillful use
- {用|もち}いる: to use, to employ — literary or formal; used in writing more than speech
